title: Black Woman Nubian Princess Queen
author: Yayasvg
description:
Cut and print the designs.
All files are ready to cut in SVG or DXF (eps included also)
Our drawings are ready for printing for shirts, framing, making cards or party decorations, etc. (clipart and jpg ) (including glitter if shown on image,but only for PNG and JPG format)
THIS SET INCLUDED
DXF for your Cutting Machines
SVG for your Cutter
EPS
PNG to be used as clipart
JPG for printables or iron on transfers
In the EPS,SVG files you will find all the designs that you see in the pictures.
*The text font is not included. ( only the word in the picture is included)
*The background behind the design is not a cutting file.
*The tshirt behind the design is not included Is just for presentation .
